messages.snippet: Colleagues, The document management system (NetDocuments) will be unavailable from 22:00 Saturday 17
messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance: DMS upgrade this weekend
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

The document management system (NetDocuments) will be unavailable from 22:00 Saturday 17 January to 06:00 Sunday 18 January for a scheduled upgrade. Please check in any open documents beforehand. Email and the signing platform are unaffected.

IT Helpdesk | Whitfield Carter LLP
